title: Rental
noMachines: Add your machines to the garage first. They will appear here.

upsell.title: Rental option
upsell.text: Hire out your machines without paper: rental calendar, check-out and check-in reports, photos, signatures and a PDF report sent to the customer.

points.agenda: Calendar: machines on hire, booked or available at a glance
points.checks: Guided report, tailored to each machine, with photos and videos
points.sign: Customer and hirer sign on a tablet or phone
points.pdf: PDF report sent to the customer and kept in the machine’s log
